thread.title: Apple plans new U.S. campus, to pay $38 billion in foreign cash taxes | Reuters

author: Reuters
title: Apple plans new U.S. campus, to pay $38 billion in foreign cash taxes | Reuters
text: (Reuters) - Apple Inc (AAPL.O) will open a new campus as part of a five-year, $30 billion U.S. investment plan and will make about $38 billion in one-time tax payments on its overseas cash, one of the largest corporate spending plans announced since the passage of a tax cut signed by U.S. President Donald Trump. The company has been under increasing pressure to make U.S. investments since the 2016 presidential campaign, when Trump targeted the iPhone maker for making products in Asian factories...
